transcript.text: Hi everyone. I wanted to kick off our pre-launch sign-off discussion for the opening-night livestream activation plan. As we all know, the ceremony is being livestreamed from the Grand Hall on October 4, with Brightline Mobile as our presenting sponsor. The draft plan currently has a Brightline logo on the stage backdrop, a ten-minute commercial break, audience email collection for sponsor follow-up, and a host thank-you during the award presentation. Before we lock the rundown and any public-facing materials, I need to review the plan against sponsorship contracts, broadcast traffic, and audience-data compliance. I'd love to hear from each of you on anything I should be aware of in those areas.
